verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages link a public "Track Status" / "Track Application Status" lookup across patents, designs, trademarks and GIs. It resolves to a public application-status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in with no account named. Case-level visibility also exists through public Cause Lists and Controller's Decisions. The evidence is mostly navigation labels rather than in-depth documentation of the lookup's contents. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what status fields and history are shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the lookup works without login.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
